aggressive_definition: Incident lethal prostate cancer; the abstract does not further define lethal disease.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: In the incidence analysis, we observed 695 lethal prostate cancers during 879,627 person-years.
study_design: Prospective cohort incidence analysis in the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study, with a separate case-only postdiagnosis survival analysis.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We prospectively examined the intake of these nutrients and the risk of lethal prostate cancer among 47,896 men in the Health Professionals Follow-Up Study.
reason: The prospective incidence analysis evaluated lethal prostate cancer in initially cancer-free men. The separate postdiagnosis analysis was survival rather than incidence, and the abstract did not report total prostate cancer incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Men in the highest quintile of choline intake had a 70% increased risk of lethal prostate cancer (HR: 1.70; 95% CI: 1.18, 2.45; P-trend = 0.005).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate explicitly concerns incident lethal prostate cancer in the prospective incidence analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Our objective was to examine whether dietary choline, choline-containing compounds, and betaine (a choline metabolite) increase the risk of lethal prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The abstract explicitly identifies betaine as an exposure in the lethal prostate cancer analysis; the row's numeric estimate is supplied by existing full-text evidence.
